messages:
Maria: Quick handoff for tonight's shift (18:00-02:00 UTC). Short list of things I'm watching: noisy txn-prefix-cache alerts, occasional encoder-pool CPU spikes around ~21:00 UTC, and a telemetry ingestion lag that can cause alert bursts. Links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefix-cache and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/encoder-pool.

Jack: thanks — for the txn-prefix-cache alerts, are we still on the temporary alert filter patch? I can keep an eye and mute if it goes nuts.

Maria: yes, we have the filter in staging and a canary in eu-west. Prod patch scheduled for 22:30 UTC but not yet rolled. If you need to mute quickly: `/alert mute txn-prefix-cache 30m` or use the prometheus knob to bump the threshold. Query I use to spot the noise: `sum(rate(prefix_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (node)` — spikes on a single node usually indicate eviction churn.

Priya: FYI saw encoder-pool spike last night at ~21:12 UTC — looked like a noisy model load on pod encoder-3. Workaround is to cordon + drain the pod, the pool auto-repopulates. Commands: `kubectl -n inference cordon <node>` then `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Logs: `kubectl logs -n inference encoder-3 -c encoder --since=1h`.

Jack: copying that. If we drain, any warm cache loss tradeoffs?

Priya: small prefix cache miss increase for ~2-3 minutes while pod warms. It's within SLO usually but watch latency percentiles.

OncallBot: Deploy notice — prod deploy `deploy-2026-03-17-2028` finished at 20:10 UTC (rolling). No errors reported.

Sam: telemetry team flagged ingestion lag earlier — `telemetry.ingest_lag_seconds` jumped > 300s for ~10m at 19:45 UTC. That caused a burst of duplicate alerts for coverage checks. If you see alert floods, check query: `max(telemetry_ingest_lag_seconds)` and consider temporarily increasing dedupe window in alert manager (config: /ops/alertmanager/dedupe.yml).

Maria: Good call. Current plan: hold prefix-cache filter rollout until after 22:30 if encoder spikes stabilize. If prefix-cache alerts go > 5/minute across >2 nodes, mute and escalate to eng-sre. For encoder pool — prefer drain-and-watch vs immediate restart. For telemetry, if lag > 5m and alerts start repeating, bump dedupe to 30m and ping @eng-sre.

Jack: Got it, I'll be on watch for the prefix-cache noise and encoder pod churn.

Priya: I'll stay around for the 22:30 window to help with the rollout if we go forward.

Maria: Thanks — my number in case of page is in the rotation. If anything looks like production-impacting latency >5% p95, page eng-sre immediately. Otherwise leave notes here and I'll follow up tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
